theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.svd_U_gram
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem svd_U_gram {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (exactSVD B).U.transpose * (exactSVD B).U = 1

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.svd_V_gram
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem svd_V_gram {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (exactSVD B).V.transpose * (exactSVD B).V = 1

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.svd_U_cogram
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem svd_U_cogram {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (exactSVD B).U * (exactSVD B).U.transpose = 1

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.svd_V_cogram
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem svd_V_cogram {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (exactSVD B).V * (exactSVD B).V.transpose = 1

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.thinU_orthogonal
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem thinU_orthogonal {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (thinU B).transpose * thinU B = 1

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.thinV_orthogonal
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem thinV_orthogonal {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (thinV B).transpose * thinV B = 1

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.reconstruction
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem reconstruction {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    B = thinU B * Matrix.diagonal (sigma B) * (thinV B).transpose

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.pseudoinverse_decomposition
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem pseudoinverse_decomposition {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    pseudoInverse B = thinV B * Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B) * (thinU B).transpose

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.diagonal_sigma_inv_sigma
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem diagonal_sigma_inv_sigma {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    Matrix.diagonal (sigma B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigma B) =
      Matrix.diagonal (sigma B)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.diagonal_inv_sigma_inv
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem diagonal_inv_sigma_inv {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigma B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B) =
      Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.diagonal_sigma_inv_commute
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem diagonal_sigma_inv_commute {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    Matrix.diagonal (sigma B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B) =
      Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigma B)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.mul_pseudoinverse
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem mul_pseudoinverse {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    B * pseudoInverse B = thinU B *
      (Matrix.diagonal (sigma B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B)) * (thinU B).transpose

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.pseudoinverse_mul
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem pseudoinverse_mul {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    pseudoInverse B * B = thinV B *
      (Matrix.diagonal (sigmaInv B) * Matrix.diagonal (sigma B)) * (thinV B).transpose

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.sandwich_contract
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem sandwich_contract {a b t : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (hU : U.transpose * U = 1) (D E : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (W : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (U * D * U.transpose) * (U * E * W) = U * (D * E) * W

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.sandwich_diagonal_transpose
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem sandwich_diagonal_transpose {a t : ℕ} (U : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin t) ℝ)
    (d : Fin t → ℝ) :
    (U * Matrix.diagonal d * U.transpose).transpose = U * Matrix.diagonal d * U.transpose

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.mul_pseudoinverse_mul
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem mul_pseudoinverse_mul {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    B * pseudoInverse B * B = B

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.pseudoinverse_mul_pseudoinverse
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem pseudoinverse_mul_pseudoinverse {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    pseudoInverse B * B * pseudoInverse B = pseudoInverse B

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.mul_pseudoinverse_transpose
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem mul_pseudoinverse_transpose {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (B * pseudoInverse B).transpose = B * pseudoInverse B

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.pseudoinverse_mul_transpose
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem pseudoinverse_mul_transpose {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    (pseudoInverse B * B).transpose = pseudoInverse B * B

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.Pseudo.actual_isMP
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem actual_isMP {a b : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin a) (Fin b) ℝ) :
    IsMP B (pseudoInverse B)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.finRange_flatMap_slice
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem finRange_flatMap_slice {α : Type*} {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → List α) (j : Fin m) :
    (((List.finRange m).flatMap f).drop
      (∑ i : Fin m, if i < j then (f i).length else 0)).take (f j).length = f j

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.copyResponses_batchAnswers
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem copyResponses_batchAnswers {n : ℕ} (A : Square n)
    (schedule : Fin 15 → Plan n) (copy : Fin 15) :
    copyResponses schedule (batchAnswers A schedule) copy = planAnswers A (schedule copy)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.planAnswers_layout
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem planAnswers_layout {n : ℕ} (A : Square n) (plan : Plan n) :
    planAnswers A plan =
      plan.selected.map (fun h => fun k => ∑ i : Fin n, A i k * plan.U i h) ++
        (List.finRange plan.s).map (fun g => fun i => ∑ k : Fin n, A i k * plan.G k g)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.storedVector_append_left
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem storedVector_append_left {n : ℕ} (xs ys : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (j : ℕ)
    (hj : j < xs.length) :
    NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.storedVector (xs ++ ys) j =
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.storedVector xs j

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.storedVector_append_right
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem storedVector_append_right {n : ℕ} (xs ys : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (j : ℕ) :
    NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.storedVector (xs ++ ys) (xs.length + j) =
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.storedVector ys j

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.storedVector_map_get
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem storedVector_map_get {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (xs : List α)
    (f : α → Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin xs.length) :
    NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.storedVector (xs.map f) j.val = f xs[j]

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.observedLeft_planAnswers
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem observedLeft_planAnswers {n : ℕ} (A : Square n) (plan : Plan n)
    (h : Fin plan.selected.length) :
    observedLeft plan (planAnswers A plan) h = A.transpose *ᵥ uColumn plan h

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.observedRight_planAnswers
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem observedRight_planAnswers {n : ℕ} (A : Square n) (plan : Plan n)
    (g : Fin plan.s) :
    observedRight plan (planAnswers A plan) g = A *ᵥ (fun k => plan.G k g)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.observedLeft_copyResponses
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem observedLeft_copyResponses {n : ℕ} (A : Square n) (schedule : Fin 15 → Plan n)
    (copy : Fin 15) (h : Fin (schedule copy).selected.length) :
    observedLeft (schedule copy) (copyResponses schedule (batchAnswers A schedule) copy) h =
      A.transpose *ᵥ uColumn (schedule copy) h

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.observedRight_copyResponses
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem observedRight_copyResponses {n : ℕ} (A : Square n) (schedule : Fin 15 → Plan n)
    (copy : Fin 15) (g : Fin (schedule copy).s) :
    observedRight (schedule copy) (copyResponses schedule (batchAnswers A schedule) copy) g =
      A *ᵥ (fun k => (schedule copy).G k g)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.measurementScale_sq
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem measurementScale_sq {n : ℕ} (plan : Plan n) :
    measurementScale plan ^ 2 = 1 / (plan.s : ℝ)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.packedMeasurement_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem packedMeasurement_inner {n : ℕ} (plan : Plan n)
    (L L' : Fin plan.selected.length → Fin n → ℝ)
    (R R' : Fin plan.s → Fin n → ℝ) :
    ⟪packedMeasurement plan L R, packedMeasurement plan L' R'⟫_ℝ =
      (∑ h, dot (L h) (L' h)) + (1 / (plan.s : ℝ)) * ∑ g, dot (R g) (R' g)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.observationVector_planAnswers
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem observationVector_planAnswers {n : ℕ} (A : Square n) (plan : Plan n) :
    observationVector plan (planAnswers A plan) = measurementVector plan A

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.observationVector_copyResponses
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem observationVector_copyResponses {n : ℕ} (A : Square n)
    (schedule : Fin 15 → Plan n) (copy : Fin 15) :
    observationVector (schedule copy) (copyResponses schedule (batchAnswers A schedule) copy) =
      measurementVector (schedule copy) A

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.represent_eq_sum
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem represent_eq_sum {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    represent P c = ∑ j, c j • P j

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.represent_single
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem represent_single {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    represent P (Pi.single j 1) = P j

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.coefficientMeasurement_apply
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem coefficientMeasurement_apply {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    coefficientMeasurement P plan c = measurementVector plan (represent P c)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.coefficientMeasurement_single
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem coefficientMeasurement_single {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    coefficientMeasurement P plan (Pi.single j 1) = measurementVector plan (P j)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.coefficientMeasurement_sum
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem coefficientMeasurement_sum {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    coefficientMeasurement P plan c = ∑ j, c j • measurementVector plan (P j)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_eq_measurement_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_eq_measurement_inner {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (j k : Fin (q + 1)) :
    gram P plan j k = ⟪measurementVector plan (P j), measurementVector plan (P k)⟫_ℝ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.rhs_eq_measurement_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem rhs_eq_measurement_inner {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    rhs P plan responses j = ⟪measurementVector plan (P j), observationVector plan responses⟫_ℝ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_mulVec_eq_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_mulVec_eq_inner {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    (gram P plan *ᵥ c) j =
      ⟪measurementVector plan (P j), coefficientMeasurement P plan c⟫_ℝ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_quadratic
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_quadratic {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (c d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    dot c (gram P plan *ᵥ d) =
      ⟪coefficientMeasurement P plan c, coefficientMeasurement P plan d⟫_ℝ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.rhs_linear
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem rhs_linear {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    dot c (rhs P plan responses) =
      ⟪coefficientMeasurement P plan c, observationVector plan responses⟫_ℝ

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_hermitian
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_hermitian {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n) :
    (gram P plan).IsHermitian

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_posSemidef
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_posSemidef {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n) :
    (gram P plan).PosSemidef

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.regression_quadratic
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem regression_quadratic {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    ‖observationVector plan responses - coefficientMeasurement P plan c‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖observationVector plan responses‖ ^ 2 - 2 * dot c (rhs P plan responses) +
        dot c (gram P plan *ᵥ c)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.exists_normal_coefficients
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem exists_normal_coefficients {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    ∃ c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ, gram P plan *ᵥ c = rhs P plan responses

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_eq_pseudoInverse_mulVec
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_eq_pseudoInverse_mulVec {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    singleOutput P plan responses =
      NLA.Computation.NonadaptiveMatrixQuery.pseudoInverse (gram P plan) *ᵥ
        rhs P plan responses

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_normal
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_normal {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    gram P plan *ᵥ singleOutput P plan responses = rhs P plan responses

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.normal_measurement_orthogonal
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem normal_measurement_orthogonal {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hc : gram P plan *ᵥ c = rhs P plan responses) (d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    ⟪observationVector plan responses - coefficientMeasurement P plan c,
      coefficientMeasurement P plan d⟫_ℝ = 0

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.normal_pythagorean
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem normal_pythagorean {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hc : gram P plan *ᵥ c = rhs P plan responses) (d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    ‖observationVector plan responses - coefficientMeasurement P plan d‖ ^ 2 =
      ‖observationVector plan responses - coefficientMeasurement P plan c‖ ^ 2 +
      ‖coefficientMeasurement P plan c - coefficientMeasurement P plan d‖ ^ 2

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_minimizes
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_minimizes {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (plan : Plan n)
    (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    ‖observationVector plan responses - coefficientMeasurement P plan
      (singleOutput P plan responses)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖observationVector plan responses - coefficientMeasurement P plan d‖ ^ 2

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_batch_normal
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_batch_normal {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (A : Square n)
    (schedule : Fin 15 → Plan n) (copy : Fin 15) (j : Fin (q + 1)) :
    ⟪measurementVector (schedule copy) (P j),
      measurementVector (schedule copy)
        (A - represent P (singleOutput P (schedule copy)
          (copyResponses schedule (batchAnswers A schedule) copy)))⟫_ℝ = 0

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.represent_mem_span_iff
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem represent_mem_span_iff {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (M : Square n) :
    M ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range P) ↔ ∃ c, represent P c = M

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.represent_mem_span
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem represent_mem_span {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    represent P c ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range P)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.represent_injective
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem represent_injective {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P) :
    Function.Injective (represent P)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.matrixVector_represent_sum
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem matrixVector_represent_sum {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    matrixVector (represent P c) = ∑ j, c j • matrixVector (P j)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.orthonormalCoordinates_represent
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem orthonormalCoordinates_represent {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    orthonormalCoordinates P (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) = d

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.represent_in_orthonormal_span
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem represent_in_orthonormal_span {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    ∃ d, represent (orthonormalMember P) d = represent P c

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.orthonormal_represent_in_supplied_span
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem orthonormal_represent_in_supplied_span {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    ∃ c, represent P c = represent (orthonormalMember P) d

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.orthonormalCoordinates_reconstruct
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem orthonormalCoordinates_reconstruct {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (M : Square n) (hM : M ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range P)) :
    represent (orthonormalMember P) (orthonormalCoordinates P M) = M

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.orthonormal_representation_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem orthonormal_representation_inner {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (c d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (represent (orthonormalMember P) c)
      (represent (orthonormalMember P) d) = dot c d

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.orthonormalCoordinates_inner
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem orthonormalCoordinates_inner {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (M N : Square n) (hM : M ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range P))
    (hN : N ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range P)) :
    dot (orthonormalCoordinates P M) (orthonormalCoordinates P N) =
      NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner M N

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_orthonormal_transport
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_orthonormal_transport {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (plan : Plan n) (c d : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    dot c (gram P plan *ᵥ d) =
      dot (orthonormalCoordinates P (represent P c))
        (gram (orthonormalMember P) plan *ᵥ orthonormalCoordinates P (represent P d))

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.rhs_orthonormal_transport
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem rhs_orthonormal_transport {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (plan : Plan n) (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ)) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    dot c (rhs P plan responses) =
      dot (orthonormalCoordinates P (represent P c))
        (rhs (orthonormalMember P) plan responses)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.measurement_lower_bound_supplied
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem measurement_lower_bound_supplied {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (plan : Plan n) (α : ℝ)
    (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan α) (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    α * NLA.Computation.LinearFamilyQuery.inner (represent P c) (represent P c) ≤
      dot c (gram P plan *ᵥ c)

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_posDef_of_lower_bound
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_posDef_of_lower_bound {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (plan : Plan n) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan α) : (gram P plan).PosDef

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.gram_full_rank_of_lower_bound
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem gram_full_rank_of_lower_bound {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q) (hP : Independent P)
    (plan : Plan n) (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α)
    (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan α) :
    Matrix.rank (gram P plan) = q + 1

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.singleOutput_unique_of_lower_bound
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem singleOutput_unique_of_lower_bound {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (plan : Plan n) (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ))
    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan α)
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (hc : gram P plan *ᵥ c = rhs P plan responses) :
    c = singleOutput P plan responses

theorem_headers.name: NLA.Proofs.RE05.orthonormal_solve_supplied_normal
theorem_headers.literal_header:
theorem orthonormal_solve_supplied_normal {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)
    (hP : Independent P) (plan : Plan n) (responses : List (Fin n → ℝ))
    (c : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)
    (hc : represent P c = represent (orthonormalMember P)
      (singleOutput (orthonormalMember P) plan responses)) :
    gram P plan *ᵥ c = rhs P plan responses

theorem singleOutput_matrix_basis_invariant_of_lower_bound {n q : ℕ} (P : Basis n q)

    (α : ℝ) (hα : 0 < α) (hLower : OrthonormalMeasurementLowerBound P plan α) :
